title: Street Art in London-3
body_text: We are now in Finsbury Park to see a painting by Banksy, an internationally famous street artist. Banksy’s artworks often carry social messages, and the green tree (that) you see over there is a good example. As you can see, he created a green tree by spraying green paint on a wall behind a leafless tree. Next to the tree, there is a person who is holding a sprayer. What message does Banksy want to give us through this painting? In many people’s opinion, he is telling us that nature is having a hard time. They think (that) he wants us to take better care of it.

transcription.note: 2026-09-07: 'telling usthat' → 'telling us that'. 자습서 원본에 두 꼴이 다 있는데 추출기가 손상된 쪽을 골랐다. 공백이 **빠져 붙은** 경우라 기존 탐지기(공백이 끼어든 것만 봄)로 안 걸렸고 확인지에도 그대로 실렸다. 본문 경로가 정정 표(norm)를 안 타던 구멍도 함께 막았다. 확정된 body_text 는 고치지 않으므로 새 레코드를 만들었다 (설계원칙 7).
